The '''rescue on the ''Chimaera''''' refers to the successful rescue of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Talon Karrde]], who was imprisoned aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and his forces. Thrawn had planned to interrogate Karrde and learn the location of the hidden [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]]. The rescue was orchestrated by Karrde's second-in-command [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who sneaked aboard in a supply [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], infiltrated the detention block and escaped with Karrde on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. As a result, the previously-neutral Karrde became an ally to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and sold them the location of the ''Katana'' fleet.

==Background==
In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] was captured by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], while she was picking up the ''[[Etherway]]'' from impoundment on [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]]. Thrawn was seeking the location of the hidden [[Katana fleet|''Katana'' fleet]], which he believed was in the possession of Jade's employer, [[Talon Karrde]]. Jade decided the only way to escape Thrawn's custody was to provide the fleet's location, so, in order to keep her friends out of harm's way, she asked to be released so she could track down Karrde and obtain the location for the trade. Thrawn agreed and said that he would end the death mark on the smugglers. However, after releasing her, Thrawn tracked Jade's ship and arrested Karrde when the two met, much to Jade's anger. Jade herself was recaptured along with Karrde, who tried to telekinetically crush Thrawn’s neck but was unable to conjure the power to hurt him much, and later released him. Karrde was imprisoned aboard the Chimaera, where [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] interrogators tried to get him to give up the Katana fleet location and tried, unsuccessfully, to convince him Jade had knowingly betrayed him.<ref name="DFR" />

==Escape==
Disgusted by Thrawn's actions, Jade decided to break Karrde out of imprisonment and sought the assistance of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who she despised for his role in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and had vowed to kill in the past. Skywalker agreed to assist her, and the two infiltrated the Chimaera in a supply [[Shuttle 37|shuttle]] in the [[Wistril system/Legends|Wistril system]]. Disguised in [[TIE pilot]] uniforms and using stolen passwords to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into the [[Computer/Legends|computers]], Jade and Skywalker reached the detention block and freed Karrde, who remained in good spirits because the worst stages of the interrogation had not yet begun. The trio then escaped the detention area through the [[Garbage compactor/Legends|garbage compactor]] and Karrde donned a TIE pilot suit himself.<ref name="DFR" />

[[File:FalconEscapesChimaera-DFR5.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] escapes from the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']].]]

Upon learning of the escape, Thrawn shut down the ship's computer and sounded an alert. After correctly deducing Skywalker was among the rescue party, the Grand Admiral ordered his [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], [[Rukh/Legends|Rukh]], to collect all the [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamiri]] from the Star Destroyer's engineering and systems control bays and bring them to the hangar, with the hopes of preventing the Jedi from escaping. Karrde, Jade and Skywalker were unable to reach their supply shuttle due to Thrawn's alert, so Karrde suggested they steal a vehicle from deep storage instead. There they found the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], which, unbeknownst to the trio, had earlier been captured over [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Thrawn deduced they would find the ship and ordered his troops to stop them, but he was too late. Skywalker and Jade cut, Force pushed, and shot their way clear, while Karrde piloted the Falcon out of storage and out the hangar bay. While Skywalker held off pursuing [[TIE series/Legends|TIEs]] from the gun turret, Karrde flew along the Chimaera's hull and exhaust trail, which maximized his cover until he could jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and escape.<ref name="DFR" />

==Aftermath==
Although Karrde had previously attempted to remain neutral in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], his capture made the smuggler realize that Thrawn was his enemy. As a result, immediately after escaping the Chimaera, the trio went to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and Karrde decided to sell the Katana fleet's location to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="DFR" />
